title: Kissed Earthy Vietnamese Bulgur Wheat Nem Nuong
description: Earthy and fluffy Vietnamese dish featuring bulgur wheat, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this nem nuong is diabetic-friendly and made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur wheat in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur wheat, ground pork, mushrooms, soy sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Using your hands, shape the bulgur wheat mixture into small nem nuong, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch in diameter.
Add the sesame oil to the preheated skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the nem nuong to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and cooked through.
Serve the nem nuong hot, garnished with chopped green onions and your choice of dipping sauce.
Repeat with the remaining bulgur wheat mixture.
